name: Diffbot · Catch silent edits in published articles.
alt: Animated infographic: Diffbot, Massive and your code in a stack card, then a news article fetched via Massive. On day 1 it shows the original headline; on day 2 a reading line sweeps the page, the old headline is struck through in red and the rewritten one types in, Diffbot's extracted title updates, and a v2 dot joins the version timeline. Headline: Catch silent edits in published articles.
